name: topsolid-mcp-bridge
description: HTTP/SSE bridge exposing the local TopSolid MCP stdio server to remote clients (claude.ai web, etc).
//: SECURITY -- read bridge/README.md before changing these scripts.

1. The API key is NEVER passed as a command-line argument. Process arguments are readable by any local user (tasklist /v, wmic process get commandline, Get-CimInstance Win32_Process) and are recorded by process-audit logs (Windows 4688, Sysmon event 1). Put the key in the TOPSOLID_MCP_API_KEY environment variable; start-bridge.ps1 forwards it to mcp-proxy through the child environment (MCP_PROXY_API_KEY, which yargs maps to --apiKey).
2. --host is always explicit: mcp-proxy defaults to '::', i.e. every interface.

3. There is deliberately no script binding 0.0.0.0. Use start-bridge.ps1 -Open, which refuses to start without a key, and read the threat model in README.md first: this endpoint exposes topsolid_execute_script / topsolid_modify_script, i.e. arbitrary code execution on this workstation.
